description: Tasks (follow-ups, calls, showings…). Filter by person, assignee, type, completion, or due window (due="today"|"overdue"|"upcoming"). FUB: GET /v1/tasks.

assignedTo.description: Only tasks assigned to this user (full name).

assignedUserId.description: Only tasks assigned to this user id.

dueEnd.description: Due at or before this time.

dueStart.description: Due at or after this time.

offset.description: Rows to skip. For deep paging prefer `next`.

type.description: Comma-separated types. One of: Follow Up, Call, Text, Email, Appointment, Showing, Closing, Open House, Thank You.

name: fub_list_tasks
title: List tasks
